summary.text: David Abbott is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 18, has served in the Indiana House since 2018, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is an engineer who has served on the Rome City Town Council and the Noble County Commission.

paragraphs.text: David Abbott was born in Fort Wayne, Indiana, lives in Rome City, Indiana, and graduated from Elmhurst High School.
His career experience includes working as a design engineer with Luttmann Precision Mold, Inc., and he served on the Rome City Town Council and the Noble County Commission.
Abbott won election to the Indiana House in 2018, originally in District 82, and has represented District 18 since November 9, 2022.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026, and is the only candidate listed for District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
For 2025-2026, he was assigned to the Employment, Labor and Pensions, House Natural Resources, and Government and Regulatory Reform (as vice chair) committees.
